summary: Review-required audit trail for the live System event-log cleanup card. The app already ships the wevtutil-backed action and the repo cleanup docs describe the same log-clear flow, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear System Event Log
setting.casual_explanation: This clears the Windows System event log so existing System log entries are removed.
setting.why_people_change_it: People clear event logs when they are resetting a troubleshooting surface or intentionally removing accumulated log history after exporting it elsewhere.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Clearing the log removes existing records and they cannot be restored by the app.
setting.professional_notes: The current app uses wevtutil gli System for detection and wevtutil cl System for apply. Repo cleanup docs describe the same event-log clear action and warn that the logs cannot be recovered afterward.

allowed_values.label: Analyze System log
allowed_values.meaning: Reads current System log metadata without clearing the log.

allowed_values.label: Clear System log
allowed_values.meaning: Runs wevtutil cl System to remove System log entries.

targets.notes: There is no rollback command for a cleared event log.

app_current_implementation.notes: The live app still ships this as a first-party system cleanup card instead of through the research-provider surface.

windows_defaults.label: Windows event-log baseline
windows_defaults.applies_to: Systems where the System event log remains available until an operator clears it

states.rationale: This card represents an operator-triggered maintenance action, not a persistent default state.

windows_defaults.notes: Use detection and operator intent rather than assuming a log-clear baseline.
